description_google: MOKALEI, three wooden fare in Mo'orea's ancient caldera, Paopao, Cook's Bay. Chlorine-free biological pool, mountain views. Book one fare or the whole property for up to 16 guests.

accueil.titre: A retreat inside Mo'orea's ancient caldera
accueil.texte: Three fare beneath Mou'a Puta, the Tohiea massif and Mount Rotui. A chlorine-free biological pool, panoramic caldera views, and the quiet rhythm of the island's interior.

histoire.titre: A name that once crossed the lagoons
histoire.texte_1: Years ago, our late father named his deep-sea fishing boat in Bora Bora after his three daughters. He joined their names into one: MOKALEI.
histoire.texte_2: Today the name has a new home in the mountains of Mo'orea. Each of our three bungalows carries one of the sisters' names: Fare Moehau, Fare Kahaia and Fare Leilani.

sejour.titre: Three fare, each with its own mountain
sejour.texte: Three independent wooden fare, simple and comfortable, linked by shared outdoor spaces. Each has a fully equipped kitchen with counter dining, a living room with two daybeds, a bathroom and its own private outdoor shower. Book a single fare, or the whole property for up to 16 guests.

fares.texte: 1 bedroom · up to 4 guests. A king bed (two singles joined with a king topper) and two daybeds in the living room.
2 bedrooms · up to 6 guests. A king bed, a room with two single beds, and two daybeds in the living room.
2 bedrooms · up to 6 guests. A king bed, a room with two single beds, and two daybeds in the living room.

sejour.legende_interieur: Living area and counter dining · bathroom · private outdoor shower · bedroom

atouts.texte: One fare for a private stay, or the whole property for families, groups of friends, retreats or sports teams.
No chlorine. Plants and small fish filter the water naturally in a living ecosystem.
BBQ area, a picnic table seating 16, a fire pit, an open lawn, a swinging bed platform under the trees and the Māpē Stream Nook.
Supplied by a private well, with complimentary bottled drinking water on arrival. Wi-Fi, washing machine and drying rack on site.

vue.titre: A view few visitors ever see
vue.texte: Most photos of Mo'orea show the mountains from the lagoon. From MOKALEI you look at the western side of the Tohiea massif, the island's highest summit, and its dramatic interior ridges.

montagnes.texte: the pierced mountain, whose ridge inspired our logo
"the great mountain", linked to the Bali Ha'i of South Pacific
rising between Cook's Bay and 'Ōpūnohu Bay

soirees.texte: Dinner under the string lights of the pavilion, a fire on the lawn, and the moon rising over the caldera.

legendes.titre: Before geology, the mountains were explained by stories

legende_1.texte: In one version, the navigator Hiro tried to steal Mount Rotui. The warrior Pai's spear pierced Mou'a Puta, leaving its famous opening.

legende_2.texte: Mo'orea's ancient name recalls an octopus whose eight arms are the island's eight main ridges.

legende_3.texte: Along our stream remain an ancient grove of māpē, the Tahitian chestnut. We protect it so it can flourish again.

explorer.titre: At the centre of the island

idees.texte: The Belvédère, the ancestral path E'a Tupuna among the māpē, the Trois Pinus pass and its view over both bays.
The marae of 'Ōpūnohu Valley and the octagonal temple of Papetoai.
Temae, Ta'ahiamanu and Tiahura for snorkelling, rays and turtles with local guides.
The Route des Ananas by foot, e-bike or guided quad, through working farms.
From the Cook's Bay landing: seasonal whale watching, rays and sharks, snorkelling trips and lagoon cruises.
A few minutes away: supermarkets, bakeries, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies and banks.

reservation.texte: One fare for 4 or 6 guests, or the whole property for up to 16. Self check-in from 3:00 PM, check-out by 10:00 AM. Bookings are made through Airbnb.
reservation.adresse: Paopao, Cook's Bay, Mo'orea, French Polynesia
reservation.acces: The last stretch of road is unsealed: fine by scooter or car in normal weather, a 4WD is recommended after heavy rain.
